curatedMovie.curiosityHook: How did a tightrope walker secretly rig an illegal cable across the world's tallest buildings and step out into the void?
curatedMovie.description: In 1974, French tightrope artist Philippe Petit mounts an audacious, illicit stunt: stringing a high wire between New York's World Trade Center twin towers to perform 1,350 feet above the Manhattan pavement.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Exciting yet reflective, balancing tense real-world danger with an engaging, steady documentary rhythm.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: The documentary follows Philippe Petit’s illegal high-wire performance between the World Trade Center towers in 1974.
